decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core yogurt range with an award signal and likely low incremental carrying cost, it still has option value and no evidence yet justifies abandonment after only one year.
This cheese variation builds directly on existing capabilities, was promoted on the home page, and in a growing market the firm should keep the option open until more market feedback arrives.
Because this semi-hard cheese wheel is close to the established cheese business and there is no negative performance evidence, the prudent real-options choice is to continue and learn further.
As an adjacent spicy cheese variant that likely uses existing production and distribution with limited extra cost, it is too early to conclude that its upside will not materialize.
The new mild creamy soft cheese broadens the cheese offer within the firm’s narrow portfolio and, absent weak results, retaining it preserves upside at modest risk.
This washed-rind soft cheese fits the company’s organic specialty dairy positioning and with no clear negative signal the option should be maintained for another period.
